recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current source satisfies the Jira request after later wording refinements, and additional prose would be redundant rather than corrective.
issue_request: FHIR-13474 was Published / Persuasive for STU3 and asked for clearer ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile wording, specifically that targetProfile works for Reference() and identifies the profile that the referenced target instance must satisfy.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN revision 12839. Git commit 8336fb373a8298ffa8390f245686db7fa430d9b2 is the corresponding git-svn import, titled '#13474 - note about reference and targetProfile', and it updated source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml to say targetProfile is used when the type is Reference and applies to the target of the reference.
additional_context: The cited 2017 Zulip thread explains the same distinction: profile constrains the Reference datatype while targetProfile constrains the referenced resource. Later FHIR-37791 edits added interface behavior to these definitions but did not reverse the FHIR-13474 distinction. ElementDefinition is still active build source via source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml says profile applies to the datatype, while targetProfile is used for Reference or canonical targets and applies to the target of the reference, with conformance to at least one listed profile.

related_jiras.note: Later interface-behavior clarification edited the same profile and targetProfile descriptions while preserving the FHIR-13474 distinction.
